subject: Promo credit redemption not reflected in dashboard
messages:
From: Emma Torres <emma@streamline.ai>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-07-18T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Promo credit not visible after signup

Hi Soojin,

I signed up for Redwood yesterday using the promotional code STREAM50 that was linked on the community page. I received a confirmation email that the promo was applied, but when I log into the dashboard the trial credit balance shows $0. I attached a screenshot of the dashboard (dashboard-zero.png).

Can you confirm whether the credit was issued? We were hoping to use Redwood for a quick spike test this week and the credits would help. Account email is emma@streamline.ai; HubSpot contact ID is HS-73214.

Thanks,
Emma
Emma Torres
Head of Platform, Streamline AI
emma@streamline.ai


From: Soojin Lee <soojin@redwood.com>
To: Emma Torres <emma@streamline.ai>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>, Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-07-18T10:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Promo credit not visible after signup

Hi Emma — thanks for the report and the screenshot. Sorry for the disruption. I’ve looped in Neha (sales ops) and Dev (SE) so we can check both the promo issuance side and whether anything blocked the credit from showing up in the UI.

Quick asks that will speed things up if you have them handy:
- Redwood account email (you included emma@streamline.ai, thanks).
- The promo code you used (you mentioned STREAM50).
- Approx time of signup (was it yesterday afternoon?).

I’m going to check our HubSpot promo logs and our entitlement service; Dev, Neha — can one of you confirm coupon/entitlement status and whether a manual top-up is possible while we sort the root cause?

I’ll follow up with ETA in a couple of hours.

Best,
Soojin Lee
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference
soojin@redwood.com
+1 415-555-0123

From: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin@redwood.com>, Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-07-19T08:30:00-07:00
Subject: RE: Promo credit not visible after signup (internal)

Looping through what I see:
- HubSpot shows a coupon assignment record for HS-73214 dated 2026-07-17 17:08 UTC. Attached is a clipped screenshot of the HubSpot coupon log (hubspot-coupon-log.png).
- The coupon STREAM50 is configured as a $50 credit, valid for new signups, single-use. It looks like the coupon service created the entitlement, but the entitlement provisioning webhook to the billing/credits service failed with a 502 at 17:09 UTC (transient).
- Because the provisioning call failed, the UI never received the updated balance. The retry job usually fixes this within 30 minutes, but for a small subset we saw a retry gap (workload issue during deploy).

Recommendation: manually credit $50 to emma@streamline.ai now and confirm in the UI; then we can run a reconciliation job to correct the backend and ensure the provisioning retry path is patched. Marcus — can we approve a manual top-up for this PLG trial? I think a one-off $50 manual credit is the right quick fix to avoid blocking their spike.

Dev — will you check whether the provisioning request for that HubSpot event is replayable? If so, we can replay and reconcile after the manual credit to keep accounting tidy.

-Neha
Neha Kapoor
Sales Operations, Redwood Inference
neha_kapoor@redwood.com

From: Soojin Lee <soojin@redwood.com>
To: Emma Torres <emma@streamline.ai>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>, Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-07-21T15:30:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Promo credit not visible after signup

Hi Emma — quick update and apologies again for the hiccup.

We found that the provisioning webhook failed during a transient backend deploy and the entitlement didn’t reach the credits service, so your promo code didn’t appear in the UI. I’ve manually applied a $50 credit to emma@streamline.ai as a one-time trial top-up and attached a short receipt (manual-topup-receipt.pdf) for your records. You should see the $50 reflected in the billing dashboard within a minute — please let me know if it still shows $0 after a refresh (and try clearing cache if you hit any stale UI).

We’ve also queued a reconciliation task to replay the original provisioning event so our internal accounting is correct; Neha will confirm when that completes. As a gesture for the inconvenience we’ll extend your promotional trial window by 7 days — no action needed on your side.

Relevant docs: https://docs.redwood.com/credits/redeem — includes steps for viewing balance and using credits.

If you want, we can schedule a 15-minute call so I can walk you through the dashboard and run an initial spike with you on the account.

Thanks for flagging this and sorry again for the trouble.

Best,
Soojin Lee
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference
soojin@redwood.com
+1 415-555-0123
